description: Pose of the top camera (zed2, ZED 2i left RECTIFIED optical frame, OpenCV x right y down z forward) in the FR3 base frame fr3_link0. T_base_cam maps camera coords to base coords. EasyHeC joint mask+depth fit on live captures of the real arm, 2026-10-16 (hec_live2.py, 66 frames, depth scale fixed 1). Supersedes the 2026-10-15 recorded-frame fit.
